prompts.name: proteins
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork for an existing Chinese health desktop app. Create a SQUARE 3 BY 3 SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 9 equal square cells, one food icon centered in each. Match the supplied reference's softly rounded contemporary 3D food, realistic identifiable ingredient textures, porcelain white shallow bowls, elevated three-quarter front view, warm diffuse studio light, gentle contact shadows. Each object including shadow fits wholly within central 78% of its cell with transparent padding. Equal scale bowls. Real transparent alpha background across the whole image and between cells, no backdrop, grid, text, labels, logo, UI or utensils. Each cell ONLY the requested food, no unlisted garnish or other foods. Prepared plain cooked foods, no oily shine or sauce. Strong ingredient identity at 40px. Reference is STYLE ONLY, do not repeat its ingredients. Exact left-to-right top-to-bottom contents: TOP ROW: (1) cooked skinless chicken breast cut into thick ivory slices, visible fine fibers; (2) cooked skinless boneless chicken thigh pieces slightly darker than breast; (3) cooked lean pork slices pale pink-brown. MIDDLE ROW: (4) cooked lean beef slices dark brown with fine fibers; (5) cooked lean lamb chunks grey-brown distinct small cubes; (6) steamed cod as one ivory flaky boneless rectangular fish fillet. BOTTOM ROW: (7) steamed sea bass as small silver-skin fish portions with visible skin, not whole cod fillet; (8) cooked peeled shrimp, curved pink shrimp; (9) plain brown firm dried tofu cut into rectangular slices with tan outside and pale inside.
